svg.title: G03-approve-two-dark
svg.desc: Arimo outlined design reference. Native iOS controls are schematic. Maya reviews one whole revision, with one 68-point initial-avatar block per candidate in revision order. No per-candidate action. The requested five-current-plus-two-candidate scene is a layout-only stress fixture, not a valid six-person API seed. The default body ends above the two fixed decision targets, with the shield note fully visible.

g.aria-label: Leila and Nina must accept the exact roster. Every existing member must approve the same roster. Either can happen first.
Leila and Nina will see only drops shared after joining.
We don’t identify who declined. Nobody is asked to give a reason.
